title: Job Interview ESSENTIALS!👨‍💻 -- SLOW English Podcast for Intermediate B1!

header.titleZh: 求職面試必備！ 👨💻 -- 中級 B1 的慢速英語podcast！
header.titleEn: Job Interview ESSENTIALS!👨‍💻 -- SLOW English Podcast for Intermediate B1!

sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast, a podcast for English intermediate listeners.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語podcast，這是一個針對英語中級聽眾的podcast。

sentences.en: Today I want to practice some common job interview vocabulary some different phrases.
sentences.tc: 今天我想練習一些常見的工作面試詞彙和一些不同的短語。

sentences.en: You might need at a job interview a story about my experience with job interviews.
sentences.tc: 在求職面試時，你可能需要講述我的求職面試經驗。

sentences.en: I always keep my resume up to dat any new qualifications or experience or employment positions.
sentences.tc: 我始終保持我的履歷與任何新的資格、經驗或就業職位保持同步。

sentences.en: I add to my CV resume right away I never hand in an old resume.
sentences.tc: 我立即將簡歷添加到我的簡歷中，我從不提交舊簡歷。

sentences.en: Do you update your resume how important is it for you to keep your resume up to date?
sentences.tc: 你更新履歷嗎？保持履歷最新對你來說有多重要？

sentences.en: I have worked in a few different areas education translation and transcription but mostly.
sentences.tc: 我曾在幾個不同的領域工作過，但主要是教育翻譯和轉錄。

sentences.en: I have only ever been an English teacher.
sentences.tc: 我只當過英語老師。

tags.note: 看到 resume 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: I have only ever had part time jobs.
sentences.tc: 我只做過兼職工作。

sentences.en: I have never had a fulltime job.
sentences.tc: 我從未有過全職工作。

sentences.en: Do you have a few parttime jobs or one fulltime job I prefer part-time jobs because my schule needs to be flexible I travel a lot?
sentences.tc: 你有幾份兼職工作還是全職工作？我比較喜歡兼職工作，因為我的學校需要靈活，我經常出差？

sentences.en: I need to manage and change my schedule a lot the different time zones in the world can be difficult to manage with a fulltime job.
sentences.tc: 我需要管理和改變我的日程安排，世界上不同時區的全職工作可能很難管理。

tags.note: 看到 job 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 different 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: I think one of my biggest skills are my social skills it's one of my greatest strengths to be able to communicate very well with others.
sentences.tc: 我認為我最大的技能之一是我的社交技能，能夠與他人很好地溝通是我最大的優勢之一。

sentences.en: What are some of your greatest strengths?
sentences.tc: 你最大的優勢是什麼？

sentences.en: Sometimes don't sleep or rest and I end up feeling overworked and tired now I try to limit myself so that.
sentences.tc: 有時不睡覺或不休息，我最終會感到過度勞累和疲倦，現在我試著限制自己。

sentences.en: I don't end up feeling overworked and tired.
sentences.tc: 我最終不會感到過度勞累和疲倦。

tags.note: 看到 feeling 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: What do you consider to be your weaknesses?
sentences.tc: 你認為自己的弱點是什麼？

sentences.en: Have you ever ended up feeling overworked and exhausted it feels nice to be hired for someone to say you're hired is nice but just as it feels nice to be hired?
sentences.tc: 你是否曾經感到過度勞累和精疲力盡，被雇用感覺很好，因為有人說你被雇用很好，但就像被雇用感覺很好一樣？

sentences.en: It feels really bad to be fired.
sentences.tc: 被解僱的感覺真的很糟。

sentences.en: I got fired one year ago.
sentences.tc: 一年前我被解雇了。

tags.note: 看到 but 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 feeling 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。
看到 fired 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: It was awful I felt so lost and I felt like a failure but it's important to remember that whether you're hired or fired.
sentences.tc: 太糟糕了，我感到很失落，感覺自己很失敗，但重要的是要記住，無論你是被雇用還是被解僱。

sentences.en: You are not a failure success is a feeling you can give yourself.
sentences.tc: 你不是失敗者，成功是你能給自己的感覺。

sentences.en: You define your own success not a company not a paycheck not money not anybody but yourself.
sentences.tc: 你定義自己的成功，不是公司，不是薪水，不是金錢，不是任何人，而是你自己。

sentences.en: Have you ever been fired before how did it feel?
sentences.tc: 你以前被解僱過嗎？感覺如何？

sentences.en: What did you do to feel better?
sentences.tc: 你做了什麼讓感覺好一點？

sentences.en: Tell me about your dream job.
sentences.tc: 告訴我你夢想的工作。

sentences.en: If you liked this video like and comment down below so I can make more practice videos like this in the future.
sentences.tc: 如果你喜歡這個視頻，請在下面評論，以便我將來可以製作更多這樣的練習視頻。
